'''Bavva ale'''<ref name="GG2, 2nd" /> was a foul-tasting [[Alcohol/Legends|alcoholic]] beverage distilled from [[Moss/Legends|moss]] found on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bavva/Legends|Bavva]], a [[Nothoiin (species)/Legends|Nothoiin]] colony world.<ref name="Galactic Gazetteer">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20040325web|text=Galactic Gazetteer: Hoth and the Greater Javin|int=Galactic Gazetteer: Hoth and the Greater Javin}}</ref> Appreciation for its taste varied among certain [[Species/Legends|species]]: [[Lutrillian/Legends|Lutrillians]] loved it and visited Bavva on [[Ale/Legends|ale]]-sampling tours, whereas [[Human/Legends|Humans]] hated it, even going so far as to ban the ale from some majority-Human settlements.<ref name="Atlas" />

The planet Bavva exported its trademark ale during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="Galactic Gazetteer" /> Between the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] and [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="Date">[[Galaxy Guide 2: Yavin and Bespin (Second Edition)|''Galaxy Guide 2: Yavin and Bespin'', Second Edition]] is set "during that three [[Standard year/Legends|year]] period between [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''A New Hope'']] and [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''The Empire Strikes Back'']] movies." This period corresponds to the years [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] to [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> the [[Merchants Guild]] of the planet [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin's]] [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] served wretched Bavva ale distilled through the [[Coolant/Legends|coolant]] tubes of an [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom]] [[N21-3 power converter]] salvaged from a dry-docked [[Light freighter/Legends|stock light freighter]] called the ''[[Happy Failure]]''.<ref name="GG2, 2nd" />

==Behind the scenes==
Bavva ale was first mentioned in the [[1989]] [[West End Games]] sourcebook ''[[Galaxy Guide 2: Yavin and Bespin]]'', a supplement for ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="GG2">''[[Galaxy Guide 2: Yavin and Bespin]]''</ref>
